name: ProgressCircle
summary: Compact progress in a ring, for a file chip, a card corner or a table cell.
useWhen: Progress of a task in little room: a file chip, a card corner, a table cell, a toolbar
Many small tasks side by side, one ring each, with the name in text next to it
A busy sign that becomes a known value once the task reports one
avoidWhen: There is room for a labelled bar
A measured value that is not a task, such as storage used
A short wait with no value and no change to a value later
The exact value must be read at xs or sm size

value.description: Progress from 0 to max. null or undefined gives the indeterminate form. Values out of range are clamped.

max.description: The value that means done. The minimum is always 0 (Radix Progress).

label.description: The accessible name, set as aria-label: Uploading board-cover.png. The ring has no visible label part; put the name in text next to it.

showValue.description: Shows the value text inside the ring. Default true at md and lg, false at xs and sm. Turning it on at xs or sm spills the text out of the ring; show the value next to the ring instead. Never shown while indeterminate.

valueText.description: (value, max) => string for the value text and aria-valuetext. Keep it short to fit the ring: at most about five characters at md and seven at lg, for example 7/12. The text does not wrap. Default: a whole percent with Western digits.

loadingLabel.description: What aria-valuetext says while indeterminate. Arabic default under lang ar: جار التحميل.

size.description: Diameter 16 (size.icon.md), 24 (size.icon.lg), 44 (size.control.lg) and 68 px (size.control.lg plus size.icon.lg) at the default density; md and lg follow density. Ring 2, 3, 4 and 6 px. md is 44 px, not the 32 px control md: a percent must fit inside the ring.

tone.description: Indicator color. accent is color.primary.on-surface; the others are color.state.<tone>.border, which holds 3:1 on the track and the page in every style (WCAG 1.4.11).

a11y.role: progressbar (Radix Progress) with aria-label, aria-valuemin 0, aria-valuemax, aria-valuenow and aria-valuetext
a11y.announce: Not a live region: a screen reader reads the label and aria-valuetext when it reaches the ring. The value text inside the ring is aria-hidden, since aria-valuetext says the same. Say a finish once in a Toast or a status line.
notes: The ring is a round border cut by a conic gradient mask; there is no SVG stroke and no stroke-dashoffset. A value change swaps the mask at once: only transform and opacity animate.

Indeterminate turns a quarter arc with transform: rotate. Under reduced motion it stops as a dashed full ring in the full tone color, a shape no value can take (a still quarter arc reads as 25 percent), and aria-valuetext says Loading.
The ring fills clockwise from 12 o'clock in both directions: a clock face does not mirror in RTL.
Ring contrast: every tone color is a state border color specified for 3:1 against the track and the surface (WCAG 1.4.11).
Under forced colors the track is GrayText and the indicator Highlight.
WCAG 2.2.2: the indeterminate loop has no pause control; a busy indicator is essential motion, and it stops under reduced motion.
The percent is rounded down, so an unfinished task never shows 100%.
label is the accessible name, never shown: the ring has no label part (anatomy.md rule 7, the icon only exception). Put the same words in text next to the ring.

en.label: Name the task and its object: Uploading board-cover.png. The same words usually sit next to the ring as visible text.
en.value: A whole percent, or a short count that fits the ring: 7/12.

ar.label: Noun form, no diacritics: رفع ملف الغلاف.

react.note: Shares format.ts with ProgressBar (Intl.NumberFormat, Western digits) until packages/shared/src/number.ts lands.

native.note: The conic mask has no React Native form; expect two rotated halves with Reanimated.

styles.studio: An overlay 10 ring; accent is the strongest text color (near white on dark, near black on light), as Studio has a neutral primary.
styles.desk: The same ring; accent is yellow on dark and dark gold on light.
styles.neutral: Planned: the brand color for accent.
styles.liquid: Planned: the same ring on solid content.

mistakes.wrong: A ring with no text near it and only a percent inside
mistakes.right: The task name in text next to the ring, and label set to the same words

mistakes.wrong: A long valueText such as 7 of 12 files inside an md ring
mistakes.right: A short count (7/12), or a ProgressBar

mistakes.wrong: A ProgressCircle as a decorative busy sign
